SELECT p.id, p.kind, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.title, p.image_key, p.avatar_leaf, p.avatar_leaf_color, p.description FROM people_chats p
                 JOIN people_members m ON m.chat_id = p.id
                 WHERE m.member = ?1 AND m.left_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
                 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT chat_id, member, role, added_by, joined_at, settings, muted, silenced, silenced_until FROM people_members WHERE chat_id = ?1 AND left_at IS NULL
                 ORDER BY joined_at, CASE WHEN member LIKE 'user:%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, member
after:
SELECT p.id, p.kind, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.title, p.image_key, p.avatar_leaf, p.avatar_leaf_color, p.description FROM people_chats p
                 JOIN people_members m ON m.chat_id = p.id
                 WHERE m.member = ?1 AND m.left_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
                 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT chat_id, member, role, added_by, joined_at, settings, muted, silenced, silenced_until FROM people_members
                 WHERE left_at IS NULL AND chat_id IN (
                   SELECT p.id FROM people_chats p JOIN people_members m ON m.chat_id = p.id
                   WHERE m.member = ?1 AND m.left_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
                 )
                 ORDER BY chat_id, joined_at, CASE WHEN member LIKE 'user:%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, member

assumptions.data: The original registry axis:10rooms×scale,100retained opaque rows/room, half DM2human owners/half group7humans+1agent; one declared synthetic owner sees every room.
assumptions.relationships: Original source DDL/ownership migrations/unique project names and independent project-chat IDs; SQL-only blobs/checkpoints are not valid Loro.
assumptions.scope: Warm readonly single-reader SQLite; no writers, native relay mutex wait, Rust HashMap/DTO mapping or rendering. No production proportions or app-latency claim.
assumptions.instrumentation: Same cached bundled SQLite3.46 scanstatus driver for both arms. Actual SELECT preparation, execution and column consumption included. Baseline Cdriver copies chat IDs to issue its N queries; new arm consumes2SELECTs without native mapping.
assumptions.rows_read: Logical summed SQLite NVISIT loop visits, not physical disk reads.
